correctness.rationale: Fresh exact finite-field recomputation rebuilt PG(2,13), the three graph sets, all 183 line incidences, tangents and spectra. It reproduced W21 direction set {1,3,4,5,8,9,10,12} with spectrum 1:126,2:18,3:36,8:3; W23 with ten stated directions and spectrum 1:96,2:52,3:32,6:1,10:2; and W24 with eleven stated directions and spectrum 1:91,2:59,3:16,4:14,6:2,11:1. Separate exhaustive direction-count scans reproduced N=9 count zero for all monomials, binomials, monic trinomials, and normalized degree<=6 polynomials. The original text nevertheless made a false global-status statement that size 22 remained open; Kadoo (2010) reports size-22 Redei-type existence. The repaired claim removes that statement while keeping the verified low-complexity graph exclusion.
